capabilities: Adds sticky notes, text and seven shapes to canvases
Draws freehand marker lines in five colors
Provides frames, a minimap, zoom and snap-to-grid
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux). No network requests, accounts or telemetry; images picked from the computer are copied into the vault. Board JSON format is documented for scripts and AI agents.
intentEvidence: a minimap on top of the core Canvas
problem: Core Canvas lacks whiteboard tools such as sticky notes, shapes, freehand drawing, frames, layers and a minimap.

relations.evidence: it provides the shapes and card styles Cult Canvas builds on

summary: Whiteboard layer for Obsidian canvases adding sticky notes, shapes, a freehand marker, frames, layers and a minimap on top of core Canvas.
